items.item: Compares lookup and master-detail on sharing, ownership, cascade delete and roll-up summaries
items.evidence: Table: Sharing | Inherited from Account | Invoice has its own OWD; Ownership | No owner | Has an owner; Cascade delete | Always | Optional; Roll-ups | Native | Not native

items.item: Raises data skew (more than about 10,000 child records under one parent) and its locking and sharing-recalculation effects
items.evidence: The data skew threshold is about 10,000 children per parent... Parent locking: ... UNABLE_TO_LOCK_ROW... Sharing recalculation: with master-detail, changing an Account's owner or sharing forces recalculation across 100,000+ children.

items.item: Gives a recommendation with the reason
items.evidence: Recommendation: use a Lookup to Account, not master-detail... Roll-ups can be replaced, and the other two don't outweigh the skew risk at this volume.
